claims: The public upstream repository was cloned at the exact commit.
The upstream test suite passed in a temporary isolated virtual environment.
TraceGate compiled and replayed read-only file-analysis traces derived from that snapshot.
limitations: This is a maintainer-run compatibility pilot, not evidence of an external adopter.
The upstream test result is recorded metadata and is not an authenticated evaluation receipt.
The install timing is one local smoke measurement, not a performance benchmark.
No upstream source content is redistributed; only paths, sizes, and SHA-256 digests are retained.
